title: Add actor metadata when seeding tasks
summary: Allow autonomy-seed-next to record which role seeded a task and why, so events.jsonl can be audited without guessing the actor or intent.
expectedFailureModes: Seed events all look identical, obscuring whether they were seeded by a planner or an automation loop.
Invalid role strings are accepted and break autonomy validation later.
Notes capture machine-local identifiers that should never land in public history.
nextAction: Teach autonomy-seed-next to accept --actor and --note flags and apply them to the recorded seed event.
